body:
Ensure ticket-store validation errors end with a pointer to `adlc ticket schema` and `adlc ticket doctor`, reconcile `create --help` with `update --help` on `--authorize` and `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS`, clarify `duration` type and `edges` direction in `ticket.schema.json`, and rebuild the Cursor MCP bundle.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Loading a store with `duration: "M"` produces a validation error batch ending with `see \`adlc ticket schema\` and \`adlc ticket doctor\`` once per batch. Verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/store.test.mjs`
2. `adlc ticket create --help` no longer mentions `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS` as a requirement for writes and states the `--authorize` rule matching `update --help`. Verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/help.test.mjs packages/tickets/test/cli-help.test.mjs`
3. `adlc ticket schema` and `packages/tickets/schemas/ticket.schema.json` show the type on `duration` and the direction sentence (`this ticket completes before \`to\``) on `edges`, and the Cursor MCP bundle matches official builder output. Verify: `node --test packages/tickets/test/help.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-boundary.test.mjs`
title: tickets: point loader errors at adlc ticket schema and reconcile create/update help (#892)
